jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.c: Give her gifts while both of you are in water (or rain); she keeps summoning vortexes that disturb your actions.
jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.m: Give her gifts while both of you are in water (or rain); she keeps summoning vortexes that disturb your actions.
jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.d: Give her Regeneration III for over 10 seconds (e.g. with a splash potion), then right-click her holding a gift.
jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.s: Give her Regeneration III for over 10 seconds first; unlike Dryads she is hostile and turns invisible, then right-click her holding a gift.
jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.d: Have the Undead Affinity effect, then right-click her holding a gift.
jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.h: Right-click her holding a gift directly (do NOT drop it on the ground).
jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.b: Carry the Wither effect and keep at least 8 Wither Roses on the ground around, then right-click her holding a gift.
jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.s: Drop the gift on the ground and wait for her to pick it up like a Piglin.
jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.m: Have the Undead Affinity effect, then right-click her holding a gift.
jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.b: Keep at least 8 honey blocks within a 9x9x9 area and avoid Poison, then right-click her holding a gift.
jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.w: Give her at least 5 different positive potion effects (without hurting her), then right-click her holding a gift.
jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.s: Give her at least 5 different positive potion effects (without hurting her), then right-click her holding a gift.
jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.y: Give her gifts while enduring the snowstorm around her (heavy Slowness and continuous damage).
jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.e: Provoke her by making eye contact so she targets you, then right-click her holding a gift while bearing her attacks.
jei.grimoireofgaia.friending_condition.s: A Jukebox playing a music disc must be within an 8x6x8 area around her, then right-click her holding a gift; progress drops quickly without music.
